Q: Can I use GPL-2.0 license for a commercial product if my code is fully public(github)? A:

YES, ONLY IF YOU comply with gpl2.0, meaning your entire project must also be open source under GPL terms.

Q: How to direct Print in PHP with select default printer from web application? A:

I see that this is a very old question and has probably been answered by the poster. But here is an answer anyone can use.

The easiest way to print something under Windows, Linux, BSD, and Mac is to print your output to a file (like OUT.DAT) and then send it to your printer.

In Windows you can use: print /d:<printername> <filename>
In Linux you can use: lp OUT.DAT
In BSD you also can use: lp OUT.DAT
On the Mac you also can use: lp OUT.DAT

In PHP you'd use either SYSTEM() or EXEC() to do the above command.

Note: Under Windows you may need to research the name of your printer.

Q: Unable to read sqlite table from "Python in Excel" A:

Brother problem isn't SQL, The problem is WHERE ur codes runnin.

U use"=PY()" in excel, Python code runs in a "cloud" env, not your local computer. So, your code isn't running where you think it is :)

The path "C:\Users\benpr\mu_code\nbssh.db" doesn't exist where your code is running.

SQLite doesn't raise error if db don't exist. Instead, creates a new db. That's why u get "no such table: results" on each cycle of process.
